preContactMeshVolumes.interpretation: The pre-contact cup keeps its liquid during the initial lift; frame 55 is already in the initial pour, after the first confirmed contact at frame 54.

allFrameDomainClearanceM.note: An open-side clearance below two cells can indicate already clipped liquid. Do not tighten that side based on this bake.

lateOutflow.interpretation: The open Y domain is reached after floor contact. Late reconstructed totals include the cup, attached streams and floor liquid; boundary escape and mesh reconstruction affect these totals. Their decrease is not a measured flux budget or a claim that all missing volume was poured from the cup. Cup-connected volume includes attached streams.

contacts.interpretation: Twelve observed primary landings are exported. Native SPRAY is visible, but its tracker confirmed no additional landings; ambiguous or unconfirmed contacts are not invented.

limitations: Rotating-frame dynamics omit Coriolis, Euler and centrifugal forces; world remapping is geometrically exact but does not restore those forces.
Surface tension is zero; measured capillary physics has not been validated.
SPRAY rendering sizes are visual approximations, not measured droplet diameters or masses.
Mobile viewport and touch behavior were checked in real desktop browser engines; a physical iPhone/Android device was not used.
